label: Secondary Index
type: an index on document fields other than the key. The docs state this IS a Global Secondary Index (GSI).
note: MERGE LICENCE ON THE RECORD: both index-service.md and indexes.md independently state that a secondary index is a GSI, which is the explicit source statement the never-merge-without-evidence rule requires - two-page recurrence, so the merge is licensed rather than inferred. Kept as a distinct id from index-type:gsi, linked by isSynonymOf rather than collapsed, because the docs use both surface terms and a reader searching either should land somewhere.
